Name: Shaharaim
Summary: Begat children in the country of Moab after sending away his wives Hushim and Baara.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:8: Begat children in the country of Moab after sending away his wives Hushim and Baara.
LifeLesson: The mention of Shaharaim in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
